name: Update for Sentinel Thenysil
objectiveText: Return to Sentinel Thenysil in Ashenvale.

comments.body: Does anyone find it odd that the Pre-Req quests in this Chain are a higher level than "Update for Sentinel Thenysil"
Must complete Charred Vale and Wounded Spirits to obtain this quest.

this quest does appear after Wounded Acients i think, at least thats when i found it. only its a way low level compared to Wounded Ancients so there is no '!' above her head, i juts got a speach bubble.

i've practicly run this one twice now, i accepted t6he quest and ran all the way up the mountain, hopped a flight to Astranaar and started looking for the sentinel...only to find i hadent accepted the quest properly, must have missed the button or something. so i had to run all the way back to accept it and then back to Astranaar again! who ever heard of a blond night elf?

This quest is unlocked by two other quests,
'Enraged Spirits' and 'Wounded Ancients'.

'Reception from Tyrande' has the final reward for this thread.

To see the complete thread, have a look under the Ashenvale quest 'On guard in Stonetalon' since the complete chain is not revealed otherwise at present time.

Have fun, and do this before you reach lvl 40,
reward should hopefully be more useful around low 20's...
